access.read: admin or owning developer / team member
access.create: admin or owning developer / team member
access.update: admin or owning developer / team member

fields.name: billing_interval
fields.label: Billing Interval
fields.description: How often this plan bills. Quarterly = 3x the monthly price; Annual = 10x (2 months free). Set from the developer's own request (Placements tab) or by an admin.

fields.name: extra_featured_slots
fields.label: Extra Featured Slots
fields.description: Additional featured-project slots beyond the plan's included amount, at that plan's per-extra-slot price (see src/lib/packages.ts) — clamped server-side to whatever the plan actually allows.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Set to "active" once payment is confirmed — activates the plan automatically (see hooks/sync-developer-plan.ts). No live gateway yet, so this is a manual step, same as Payments today.

fields.name: founding_discount_applied
fields.label: Founding Developer Discount Applied
fields.description: Whether this subscription's amount includes the 40% founding-developer discount (packages.ts). Decided once, at activation — never recalculated afterward.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Snapshot of the price (plan + any extra slots, x the billing interval, minus 40% if founding_discount_applied), from src/lib/packages.ts — for every fixed-price tier this is set automatically and shouldn't be hand-edited. Exception: `campaign` has no fixed price (negotiated per deal) — an admin sets the real agreed amount here after creating the subscription.

fields.name: cancel_at_period_end
fields.label: Cancel at period end
fields.description: A developer can check this to cancel — the plan (and every featured project it grants) stays active until the renewal date, then everything reverts to Free.

fields.name: provider_subscription_id
fields.label: Provider Subscription ID
fields.description: Placeholder for a future payment gateway (e.g. PayHere) subscription reference.
